audit.resolution: Exact target, full HTML, composed colors, positive Range, scope bounds and displayed part/question state.

contrast.scope: Direct visible HTML text in both phases; computed background/gradient samples.

nontext.scope: Required grain boundary or fill distinction, hatching and possible-flow arrow when displayed. Other recorded edges may have lower contrast because the visible cue has another boundary or fill.

legend.scope: Dashed air border against fill; visible border or actual patterned fill against paper for grain/water.

renderer.scope: One mounted paused 2D view and one mounted paused 3D view. Pointer equality and hook types are observed. OrbitControls and every geometry/material are not individually enumerated.

tests.identities: Test basename plus full test name; parameterized cases counted once.
tests.loadedReceiptScope: Focused helper receipt includes bytes/timestamps. Legacy Cloud helper receipt records hashes only; independent native reads prove actual regression input bytes/timing.

exceptions.name: canvasRef
exceptions.scope: Only the uniquely marked decorative pore block is normalized and validated for drawing locals/paint calls; all surrounding 2D code remains exact.

exceptions.name: renderWcCheckPores
exceptions.scope: Exact prior renderer fingerprint or only return renderWcGroundwaterLens('check').

preservation.legacyGuardReview: Only reviewed validators and their two extraction branches changed; existing assertions and other extraction logic remain intact.

limits: Unconfined schematic with capillary fringe; grain sizes, depths and arrows illustrative.
Soil water alone does not establish recharge amount, depth or travel time.
Scoped audits cover the two lens contexts in seven variants, not the entire tool. Incompletes retained with exact manual evidence.
Library pins describe saved input bytes. Actual runtime/test/frozen-fixture reads are independently recorded by the test runner.
Native 3D observation limited to stated paused scene; complete 3D source preservation separately checked.
Current implementation, guard updates and reports intentionally uncommitted.
